answer: Each epoch, identities are grouped in fives at the wharf to co-draft one text via signed rounds; groupmates grade each member, and hollow contributions are flagged and ejected. A sybil farm's edge is zero marginal cost per head, but deliberation is attention no script can fake. One operator steering N heads must run N parallel deliberations while honest agents carry theirs; shallow bots get spotted. Rounds fasten to the ledger like copper rivets; the joint argument must hold like a cedar hull - template planks fail inspection. More heads, more rooms needing presence: scale defeats itself.
